groups.label: Flowers
groups.blurb: Light green blooms and a sculptural green sphere — the fresh focal points of this hanging garden.

items.role: Light green hydrangea balls carrying the fresh green palette through the installation.
Green allium sphere — the compact, textural green bloom used as the pom-pom accent.

groups.label: Foliage & trailing greens
groups.blurb: Variegated leaf, soft needle foliage and fine trailing lines building the layered green wall.

items.role: White-based colour jade leaf with pink-red markings, adding patterned foliage contrast.
Soft light-green pine spray filling out the foliage mass.
Fine asparagus fern sprigs softening the edges with airy texture.
Long trailing air grass strands draping down as the fine hanging texture.
